source.publication: Rhode Island Retirement Income Tax Guide, Publication 2026-01 (tax year 2025)
source.section: Instructions PDF pp.9-10, Schedule M line 1t, questions 1 and 2 and table lines 1-4; Guide PDF p.20, Section 5 Example #4; Instructions PDF p.4, RI-1040 lines 1-5; PDF p.5, lines 6-8; PDF p.13, Tax Computation Worksheet ('Use for all filing status types')

worked: Federal AGI = wages 50,000.00 + public pension (federal) (person 0) 55,000.00 + employer plan distributions 20,000.00 = 125,000.00. Federal taxable income = 125,000.00 - 31,500.00 standard deduction - 2 x 1,600.00 age 65+ = 90,300.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 125,000.00. Line 1t: question 1 born on or before March 1, 1959: person 0 born 1957-06-15 (age 68), person 1 born 1958-02-15 (age 67): yes; question 2 federal AGI 125,000.00 less than or equal to 133,750.00: yes. Table: person 0 line 2 55,000.00, line 3 lesser of that and 50,000.00 = 50,000.00; person 1 line 2 20,000.00, line 3 lesser of that and 50,000.00 = 20,000.00; line 4 = 70,000.00. Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 70,000.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 0.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 0.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 70,000.00 = -70,000.00; RI-1040 line 2 = -70,000.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 125,000.00 + (-70,000.00) = 55,000.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: line 3 55,000.00 is not more than 254,250.00: the worksheets stop at line 3, full amounts. Line 4 standard deduction: 21,800.00 (Married filing jointly). Line 5 = 55,000.00 - 21,800.00 = 33,200.00. Line 6 exemptions: 2 x 5,100.00 = 10,200.00. Line 7 taxable income = 33,200.00 - 10,200.00 = 23,000.00. Line 8 tax on 23,000.00 by the schedule as numbers: 23,000.00 x 0.0375 = 862.500000 = 862.50. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 862.50. Note: Guide Example #4 (Michael 68, Charlotte 67). 50,000 of his federal pension and her 20,000 from the 401(k): 70,000. The Guide says 'a total of $45,000' in one sentence; its pension and plan figures add to 75,000, and it reaches 70,000 as here.
